nom: The INKEY List Hydrocolloid Invisible Pimple Patches + Salicylic Acid

avis.texte: These were literally the only pimple patches that acually work all the others never do anything but these are life changing!!

Had a huge under the surface kind of zit and a date the same night, I bought these hoping for a miracle. Now, it's not like everything was magically gone away BUT …I slapped the patch on and four hours later I had the most massive white head. I touched it and it popped. Gross, to be sure (and what's up with all the gunk in my pores?!?) but this was legit. Much easier to cover, not so red, and much smaller. And because at this point o wanted to know if it consistently worked that way, when my boyfriend developed a pimple, I tested it on him. Same results. It's kind of amazing!

These patches didn't help with anything, wore them overnight no noticable change. Left a white wierd circle where I put them after taking them off. Tired again and nothing changed, will not purchase again.

these patches adhere so well. theyre easy to remove from their sheet if you follow along the perferated line. they are truly unnoticable (unless a ton of gunk is sucked up). i have oily skin and lately more oily than usual and yet these patches dont budge. removing my white head everytime. only downside is i wish there were two sheets in the package instead of one.

Albeit tied with the cosrx pimple patches, i find these patches are the best. Theyre super invisble, they really take the pimple down. I particularly use them after a high frequency wand with some salicylic acid under the patch. These are my most recommended.

I've tried 4 brands of pimple patches and these are the ones I hated the most. They are very expensive for getting 1/3 the amount of patches that other brands offer for the same price. And are super thin and way too sticky, so they are hard to peel off the packaging without wrinkling them or folding up a side. Also, the surface area that's supposed to be over the pimple is so small. I had no results at all and instead it ripped the top layer of my skin off in certain areas. I do NOT recommend these at all.
Have bought alot of pimple patches for teenager boys and girls and they all say these ones are the best!
These patches stay in well and look fairly invisible. They work best on red rather than white spots.
I usually put these on overnight and leave them on for 24 hours, pimple and gunk 90% gone by the end, incredible. Different sizes too. Good invisibility
I love these, they work to reduce the redness, swelling and time of spots. I buy these on repeat.

These aren't really a necessity but can be very helpful. If applied correctly they are invisible. I would recommend these especially to people with oily skin that often struggle with patches falling off

These are great little patches of magic. Pop them on your spot overnight and remove the next morning and the spot is much improved. It seems to calm the irritation and reduces redness. Use sparingly and they will last a while.
Tried cheap ones, and expensive ones and these are mid range but the best. Effective and quick!

These are wonderful! I love how truly invisible they are & they get the job done fast. No residue left on skin after use and they pull the gunk out without harming the skin. Was gifted the sample pack by Inkey and will definitely repurchase!
Wonderful, some of the best acne patches I have ever tried! Invisible almost
Always use to use the cheap patches and never found they did anything. These are amazing. Spots cleared up in a day!!!

I'm totally dependent on these patches! At this point in my life, my hormonal acne consists of multiple, shallow, small whiteheads. These patches, when I use them overnight, zap the little suckers well. Love these patches!
It drew my pimple out but burnt my skin. Now I have a scar where the patch was. Will not use again.
Great for them surprise breakout spots, gets rid of them quickly, pain free and so easy to use
Does what it says on the tin, for them big spots these are my go to, the result is quick and painless
Sooo amazing, it was so trippy how they actually were invisible over a pimple.

The patches are smaller than expected, but they work surprisingly well. They stick firmly, stay on all night, and noticeably reduce redness and swelling. Despite the small size, they do exactly what they promise

I really wanted to like these, as I love other Inkey List products, but these just aren't great. They wrinkle up very easily, aren't very sticky and you get a really small amount of surface area for the price in comparison to other brands. I can see how beneficial they can be for wearing with makeup, as they are very thin, however, i'd recommend applying them before any skincare as they lose their stickiness with the slightest bit of moisture on the face. Also be incredibly careful removing them from their packaging as they wrinkle up / lose their clarity with any contact to your fingers and will refuse to stick whatsoever. Overall, they do help with pimples in my opinion if you manage to get one on properly, but if you're the type to just throw these on in a rush before bed / work just stick with the Hero mighty pimple patches.. better bang for your buck in comparison and always reliable.

these patches are so flat that you can wear a full face of makeup over them and they will not be seen. Unlike some other patches, these truly get the goock out of any blemish or active breakout. I would repurchase these over any other brand 100% of the time
These a so great when you feel a spot coming to protect it from anymore bacteria and to protect the spot from getting bigger

Best pimple patches I've tried. Stay on overnight, as long as the skin is clean and dry when applying. I'm wearing 2 in the photo and they're quite invisible. However by the morning when they've absorbed the oil etc they do turn more opaque.
I have never really broke out before pre mentapause but now my skin is changing and being able to address these pimples with almost no scar is great.

I've only tried two patches but both times the spot hasn't hung around and has cleared away quicker than normal. Usually it can take a couple of days of a red, angry lump forming and then weeks to clear up so I'm pretty impressed so far!
Works really well! Most of the times, the pimple is gone within a few hours, without damaging the skin. Will keep buying them
I've been using pimple patches more often, and I loved these ones. They get out so much oil, and I don't even mind wearing them outside b/c of how transparent they are.

Was hoping these would work were others had failed. Really sticky so no fear of falling off and stayed on all night. Had a large red lump on my chin, stuck a patch on went to bed 7 hours later the patch was whitish as it had drawn all the gunk out.

These only work for whitehead type pimples, and after using 1 night, unfortunately didn't make much of a difference in pimple size. I usually use the Hero cosmetics patches but wanted to try these, i think the Hero ones work much better though
These work great! Wear overnight to coear out a pimple. I also have pimples that never get a head, and wearing these consistently for a few days helps resolve them.

I have tried patches from several brands including peach slices, cosrx and hero. These are by far the best and fastest. They pull stuff from your pores within minutes of application. My only wish is that they came in even larger sizes for the major bumps I get during my period.

I don't know if I'd say they miracle spots away exactly, but they do a stellar job of making them invisible! I just slap on a few of these when I breakout and keep the makeup to a minimum and no one sees a thing all day. They can be a bit finicky and I've seen me throw one or two away because the way they peel sometimes they get stuck to themselves and then they can't be used. But I use tweezers to unpeel and apply and 9/10 it's good

While these patches do go unnoticed, they don't really work for my acne/pimple type. If anything, it aggravates my breakouts, leaving behind a wound/bruise. I've used an entire strip and had a positive result only twice.
Takes the whitehead off any pimple/spot every time. About time I was able to find a pimple patch that works!
They really help with the occasional rude pimple that bursts in my chin every now and then. They reduce redness and the inflammation.
I have been buying these for my 19 year old daughter since they came out. They dry pimples out over night. Incredible results.
Really nice product. Perfect for travelling and giving your skin a little extra help when it's not feeling 100% . A bit annoying to get them off the sheet (I always manage to wrinkle them up a bit).
Love these .. I suffer with underneath the skin spots when the time of the month comes along and these really help reduce them & bring spot to the surface .. so a firm winner
Staple product, takes the redness out of spots and reduces the swell. If the spots have a head to them also gets rid of this.
I love these patches , they work so quickly and clear my skin really fast and leave me a lot happier.

These are the first pimple patches I've used that actually work. Very handy for covering spots and you can put makeup over them, and they genuinely pull the gunk out of spots and reduce redness noticeably. Will definitely buy again. (For reference, I have dry, acne-prone and ultra-sensitive skin)
I like that you can still apply your skincare products after putting them on. They stay in place and don't slide around, which makes them super easy to wear
The patches are really invisible and can be used before doing makeup to cure acne faster. I like them
Gets rid of acne really quick even underneath skin pimples that haven't broke through yet can help you from having a really bad breakout on a special occasion prom wedding etc

avis.titre: I couldn't believe how good these were
avis.texte: I have a big spot before a night out and I used one over night and it was gone in the morning.
I have tried a few of these and I don't see the benefit. Glad I tried but not for me. I don't see the benefit.
It gives me good results. Really reduces my acne. I applied on active acne and on the other morning good good result.
Help me stop picking mu skin, reduced inflamation and pain caused by pimples under the skin

I got these for occasional menopausal spots and they definitely help to sort them out. Only slight thing is they can be a little tricky when peeling them off the backing, but I would say give them a try.

They are the best ever. I noticed the difference on the first use and I love how discrete they are. Another great one from The Inkey List! Now if only they would ship to me directly that would take it to the NEXT level 🤔
These are great at getting rid of that bruise-like pain that comes with acne.

I struggle with adult breakouts . Sometimes they're mild & other times they're worse . No exaggerating I tried about 15 different pimple patches . I bought these about a week ago . I have a few pimples that just won't go away. Used the whole box & just got another 'cause they work so well . I wore them at night & during day . Also sometimes with makeup 'cause they're that thin . Hydrocolloid is a must in a pimple patch( even tho they all don't have it) these patches shrunk the pesky pimples that would never go completely away which is why I just grabbed another box. I'm pretty sure 💪 that they'll be gone after a patch or 2 ., idk if it's the zucchini acid but it sucks the gunk out 🥵😊 and significantly shrinks the pimple. It's also a very reasonable price . I wish that I had a b4 pic
I over 60 and still break out. I have tried these patches and they work for me.
These are sticky for sure - any facial hair will come along for the ride when you take them off. However these patches are sub-par. I love Inkey products, but I won't be using these anymore.
They stay for days and when you take it out the pimple is gone!! I wait around 2-3 days. Nobody notices them!! Just wouldn't recommend to put make up on it.
Comfortable and discreet! Helps keep breakouts under control.

These pimple patches really are invisible when you first put them on. After multiple hours of having them on they might start peeling on the border, but I think that's pretty normal. They really do their job.

I bought two boxes of the pimple patches just before Christmas and they were amazing. I've tried many different patches and they were ok but these patches worked without an hour. They are so invisible that sometimes I woke up and went to work with them on and realized they were still on my face. They worked so well that I didn't need to use another one on the same spot. I've bought two more boxes and will continue to buy them.

avis.titre: Seem to work but too expensive
avis.texte: These seem to speed up some pimples' life cycle and dry them up faster. They are only good if you get a stray spot once a month. If you are a spotty teenager, using them regularly is just too expensive.

These patches really live up to their name and gets the job done. Itself are clear round dots you place on active breakouts that are coming to a head. I put them on mine and they really drew out all the junk from my pimples. It cool how you can't really tell you have a patch on your face unless someone is really close to you. I almost forgot I had them on. Great product that works really well

I have used this a lot when I break out and majority of the time the gunk is removed but sometimes it's still there but on the box it does say reapply a new patch as needed but overall this product is a life changer. However these pimple patches are not that invisible since they are noticeable but overall this product is very good and is highly recommended

avis.titre: Not a miracle worker but helps
avis.texte: These don't entirely banish pimples but they do definetly speed up the healing process, takes the worst of it out and reduces the inflammation/redness of spots. Good to have on hand.
I think these are great little pimple patches, they work well, wouldn't say magically, just like typical pimple patches.
I've used other pimple patches but these ones are the best I've tried yet! They really help to help any pimples much faster and they are hardly noticeable so I've used them during the day as well.
Use this every morning and night. Whether you have normal or dry skin, it works.
These patches are awesome, they stick to your skin flawlessly and reduce inflammation really well. Also they're barely noticeable, a win win.
Used these on forming whitehead. When removed it was still there!
My teens love these as are invisible and after having them on overnight the spit has drastically reduced. I've even used them myself and have actually forgot its on as they are so good.

I tried a couple of cheaper patches before these and the extra cost is so worth it. They are seriously effective, I've not had a spot these didn't clear yet. I have sensitive skin and they don't leave it sore or feeling like it can't breathe like the other brands I tried
Our whole family use these ! They are so good of you have spots as completely clear them in a day or two ... highly recommend!

avis.titre: Nice concept but didn't work on me...
avis.texte: I had a pimple that was bothering me so I tried a patch but after 48 hours I removed it and the pimple was still there... I had to pop it later on. So for me, unfortunately not effective. The plus is that it covers really well the pimple and is almost invisible, very well made.

Perfectly gets rid of whiteheads without leaving scars. Not as helpful with bumps without a head. However do not wear these out, as the gunk that is pulled out forms a very visible white spot on your face!
They do a great job...Pimple has "vanished" in a day..love them

I put these on some pretty gnarly breakouts I had on my chin and overnight the swelling and redness went down. These pull out some of the gunk that's on the breakouts and makes my face easier to wash and treat.
As it says on the box, only works on spots with a visible head. Sometimes you need a second one though.
Unfortunately it did nothing for me so far. But it sticks well and it prevents further infection.

the pic is after wearing overnight before removing, but when you put it on to begin with it's barely visible at all. best thing is: they work great! i feel like i have an actual solution for hormonal acne that wants to jumpscare me before my cycle lol, will be buying again!!
I have used them a few times now and they really do dry out spots. Also very invisible too, I went out to work wearing one as I forgot I had put it on and no one even saw it!
Blend in with skin well, are very sticky so actually pull heads of white heads off with removal sometimes Feel like they reduce redness of spots
I only tried once on a pimple becasue I rarely have. I left it almost 24 hours and the pimple didn't change after, when I removed the patch.
Best pimple patches I have ever used. Invisible and successful!
The best pimples patches that i tried. Gets rid of pimples really fast. The only thing is that you get to little patches.
They work well on already kind of bad pimples. With "young" ones they dont do much.
These are the first pimple patches I'ver ever used & they definitely work!!

These really stay on, and are almost invisible, which I like. It's nice for pimples that you don't want touching anything else. I don't like how few are in here for the cost though--any other hydrocolloid patch would suffice. It's also a bit hard to peel off in a clean way, it sometimes gets wrinkly where you pulled it off the sheet, so I recommend using a tweezer to apply! I dislike that the cardboard box seems a bit wasteful, when there's only 1 sheet in there. I think maybe the packaging could be smaller to reduce waste. I don't think I'd go out of my way to repurchase, due to the cost; but would be happy to use them again as rewards gifts.

Love almost all Inkey products (especially the mandelic acid), but this one is a hit or miss, sometimes the patch does absolutely nothing and I don't understand why, it's like I just put some tape over my pimple and sometimes it works and actually does his job. Personally, I'm not gonna repurchase this.

avis.titre: I wanted more of this pimple patches
avis.texte: Could you please put more pimple patches in the box they are so good I wish there were more of them 10/10
